author: claude-opus
text:
new: lernie binary with 'new' subcommand for conversation scaffolding

Per ARCH §2.2 / §12. Replaces the v0.1 shell-based new-conversation
tool with an in-process implementation.

- src/template.rs: scaffold() + GitRunner trait + RealGit. Template
  is embedded via include_dir! so the binary is self-contained. RealGit
  scrubs inherited GIT_DIR/etc. so it stays correct under git-hook env.
- src/bin/lernie.rs: clap subcommand binary; matches gen-schemas
  layout under src/bin/ so it stays excluded from coverage. clap
  chosen over argh/lexopt because v0.1 already needs two subcommands
  ('new' here, 'prompt' next).
- tests/template.rs swaps the shell script for the binary via
  CARGO_BIN_EXE_lernie. Adds tests for the new "empty pre-existing dir
  is accepted" semantics and a tightened non-empty refusal test.
- Removes scripts/new-conversation.sh; Makefile target now drives the
  binary. README updated.

100% line coverage held (296/296). clippy + fmt clean. Banned-term
grep clean across new/modified files.
